verses.english: “Mendicants, there are these five powers of a lady.
Attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior.

verses.pali: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, na ca bhogabalena—
verses.english: A lady who has the power of attractiveness but not the power of wealth

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca—
verses.english: But when she has the power of attractiveness and the power of wealth

verses.pali: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, na ca ñātibalena—
verses.english: A lady who has the powers of attractiveness and wealth, but not the power of relatives

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca—
verses.english: But when she has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, and relatives

verses.pali: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, na ca puttabalena—
verses.english: A lady who has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, and relatives, but not the power of children

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca—
verses.english: But when she has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, and children

verses.pali: Rūpabalena ca, bhikkhave, mātugāmo samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca, na ca sīlabalena—
verses.english: A lady who has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, and children, but not the power of ethical behavior

verses.pali: Yato ca kho, bhikkhave, mātugāmo rūpabalena ca samannāgato hoti, bhogabalena ca, ñātibalena ca, puttabalena ca, sīlabalena ca—
verses.english: But when she has the powers of attractiveness, wealth, relatives, children, and ethical behavior

verses.pali: Imāni kho, bhikkhave, pañca mātugāmassa balānī”ti.
verses.english: These are the five powers of a lady.”
